title: 5D link
description: A typed link between two entries; carries exactly one dimension, nothing else (spec/SPEC.md §6; §7 N1 — 5D is neutral on is/ought, owner design change 2026-10-01, supersedes an earlier link 'mode' field on this branch; see docs/decisions/0003-is-ought-in-nd-grammars.md). additionalProperties is true: an extra field an nD grammar chooses to attach (e.g. its own normative marker) is simply ignored by 5D, never rejected. The 'embeds' relation is always dimension 'structural' (used to lower a norm's content into 5D, §7 N4) — matched case- and separator-insensitively, with any run of whitespace/hyphen/underscore collapsed ANYWHERE in the string (not only leading/trailing), via the same normalisation src/five_d_nd/contract.py normalise_relation_key()/is_embeds_relation() apply in code: 'Embeds', 'EMBEDS', ' embeds ', 'em-beds', 'em_beds' and 'Em Beds' are all recognised, not only the exact literal string 'embeds'. This $id resolves once the repository is published; until then, resolve schema $refs from a local copy (see tests/test_conformance.py).
